cases.name: Deceiver of Form
cases.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, reveal the top card of your library. If a creature card is revealed this way, you may have creatures you control other than this creature become copies of that card until end of turn. You may put that card on the bottom of your library.

cases.name: Sample Herald
